description:
The Conquest of the Colosseums is brought to you by Baron of Dice! https://baronofdice.com/?ref=PiWj5cSTlKyTsZ Get your dice, tape measures, and more from Baron of Dice.

3 Colosseums Must Be Conquered! In order to be crowned King in this new season of King of the Colosseum a force must get a win in all three Colosseums: Jungle, Ocean, and Ruined City. However, one loss and the force is banished forever. 

Mubin returns to the Colosseum to fight Nick and the Genestealer Cults. Will the Brood take the Colosseum or will the Sons of Magnus claim it for themselves?
